node.statement: The dependency-scoping premise is now satisfied: the declared dependencies 1.3.3.1 and 1.3.3.2 are validated in this workspace. Node 1.3.3.1 supplies m*beta = B*beta - G*beta, and node 1.3.3.2 supplies B*beta = sum_j b_j*beta_j and G*beta = sum_k c_k*beta. Substituting these two validated identities into the validated equality m*beta = B*beta - G*beta gives m*beta = sum_j b_j*beta_j - sum_k c_k*beta, with no appeal to an unvalidated premise.
